rig: Capture opposite-control, default-pose and mirror data for the selected rig's controls.
Only the selected controls are captured; existing entries for the rest of the rig are left untouched.
default: Capture the current pose of the selected controls as their saved default.
Only attributes that differ from Maya's own attribute default are stored.
opposite: Capture and save the opposite-control relationship for the selected controls.
Controls with no matching opposite are recorded as center controls.
mirror: Test the selected controls' mirror directions and world-space orientations.
Only direction overrides required for correct mirroring are saved.
remove_selected_opposite: Remove saved opposite-control relationships for the selected controls.
clear_all_opposite: Clear all saved opposite-control relationships for every rig.
remove_selected_mirror: Remove saved mirror-direction data for the selected controls.
clear_all_mirror: Clear all saved mirror-direction data for every rig.
